Deep in Codeine! Great Experience
First of all scuse me for my not so good english, but I'll try to do my best.
Around 1996 I was a heavy smoker of weed (good venezuelan weed), but not only I also like ropinol, lexotan, valium, trips, free base(Call 'Piedra' in my country) cocaine, ketamine, and almost everything I could find to get me high(sometimes down ja!)
One night I was with a couple of girls(not too beauty but sexy enough) and a friend , and we were planning to go to a golf field near our home, we used to get inside this golf field in the fullstars night, with our walkmans and some chocolate, water and weed, but that day the weed was not so much, then we decided to try with the codeine that I heard from some other friend it was so good, then I went to the pharmacy and buy a botle of fenergan with codeine and one botle of robitesin A.C, we made a shake in a cooler, with rum and ice, and drink it all , the girls only drink a litle bit.
After drinking we light a joint, and lie down on the herb of the field, I just can say that in half an hour, I began to feel like calm a lot, and every light I see was very bright and the persons have and shining colors in their eyes, I felt like I was 300 kg, if I think to move my arms I wasnt able to do it inmediatly, I hear stranges noises around, and then a big calm in every part of my body, after other joint I felt like a mushroom, everything was shining and have to pee urgently , my mouth was like I eat sand, I was confused, when the girls talk to me about something, I answer about something diferent, it was to heavy, after that night , a use to use cocaine  or free base, all night and around 3 in the morning drink a botle of fenergan with codeine, and the mix isa bomb, you go like out of your mind, you walk a lot, and think a lot, I you fel in a state that I use to call the one thousand and one psoitions of codeine, because you are there sit down and you look to the stars, then you look to the floor, then to someone in da face, or to nowhere just lost inside your mind, but your brain is about 300 kmh x hour, like in huge rush.
